Sanjay / team — quick technical notes to address your M2 question and prep the Oct 8 sync:

- Session affinity & KV cache: Redwood supports session-scoped KV caches with sticky routing for sessions that persist across streaming connections. For rolling session IDs we recommend attaching a stable session token (signed by MedicaHealth) to the initial request so the routing layer can map to the proper cache shard. Cache invalidation options: TTL-based (recommended 30m) or explicit invalidation calls we expose in the SDK (invalidateSessionCache(session_id)).
- Streaming model: we stream tokens and events; tool-calls are emitted as structured JSON chunks (Content-Type: application/x-rwi-toolcall+json). We also support chunked JSON lines for structured outputs if you prefer newline-delimited events.
- Auth & keys: token rotation is supported via short-lived tokens (15m) issued by your KMS or our token-exchange endpoint. We'll provide example code for both flows.

Quick asks for the Oct 8 tech sync:
1) Name and email for your infra lead who will join networking & cert discussion.
2) Example of your session ID format if you can share (or confirm variable pattern).
3) Any regulatory requirements for structured outputs (PHI stripping rules) so we can pre-bake validators.

I'll put together a 1-page tech brief and a minimal SDK checklist for Marissa to share before Oct 19.

—Dev
